product_one_liner.value: Luciq is a mobile-first observability platform that captures app signals and turns them into agent-ready context for mobile engineering teams, developers, product managers, and leadership.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 194 employees and a 201-500 company-size band.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains numerous engineer-authored Engineering posts, including infrastructure, ClickHouse, AI, and observability implementation topics.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The accessible careers page does not list an AI, ML, or data-science role; the accessible live posting is for Enterprise Account Executive.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public documentation and trust material mention AI clients and agent integrations but do not identify a model provider used by the product.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round is dated May 2022, before the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 27, 2026 changelog records new product updates within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The August 11, 2026 report says Kenny Johnston left Luciq after serving as VP of Product and Chief Product and Technology Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations page names workflow, project-management, notification, incident-management, customer-service, SSO, development, and observability tools, but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
